round: relevance-filtering research round 10 (zukhruf #3195): a ranked reader, best N a day, no yes/no threshold
writtenBefore: any round-10 score. Round 9 (round-9/plan.json) was read: every yes/no design failed on fresh-3.
why: On 2026-10-29 the user chose a ranked list per interest (the reader shows the best N articles a day, best first; the user sets N) after round 9 showed that the ranking is strong and the yes/no threshold from a few taught answers is not. TREC calls ranking a stream against a profile 'routing' and scores it by average precision; filtering is the binary task. Precedent: TREC routing (Harman 1993-1998), mean average precision.
inherits: ../round-9/selection-rule.json (sha256 6909823c...) and its frozen evaluate.py (75bacc12...) for data (collection, fresh, fresh-2 as teaching pool; fresh-3 as the test slice, labels a5a871b6...), product teaching (top N by score and top N keyword matches, N in {5, 10}, yes/no from the answer key), protocols window and pool, and units. fresh-3 was scored once before (round 9, yes/no); this round asks a different question of it (adaptive reuse noted). Bootstrap seed numpy.random.default_rng(31962).

rankers.desc: order the scored stream by cos(x, d), ties by id. Taught answers are not used.
rankers.desc+kw: order by the frozen design's probability (freeze/plan.json desc|binormal+kw: binormal on cos(x, d) with the taught answers, then the naive-Bayes keyword evidence); ties by cos(x, d), then id.
rankers.truncated+kw: order by round 7's 'truncated' probability plus the same keyword evidence; ties by cos(x, d), then id.

baselines.keywordNarrow: keywords.json narrow matches first, then the other articles; inside each group newest first (publishedAt descending), ties by id.
baselines.keywordBroad: the same with the broad regex.

metrics.main: Average precision (AP) of the ranking over the scored stream's labelled articles (ambiguous left out), per profile; a profile's score = mean over its units and N. Macro mean over scored profiles (MAP).
metrics.product: Reported only: for each day of the scored stream and N_day in {3, 5, 10}, precision of the top N_day articles of that day, averaged over days; and the same for the baselines (a keyword list shows at most N_day matches, newest first).

pass: A ranker passes when, in both protocols separately: the topic-bootstrap interval of (ranker - keywordNarrow) MAP has lower bound > -0.05 (the user's non-inferiority bar), and the intervals against keywordBroad and newest lie above 0. Among passing rankers the simplest wins when its interval against the best includes 0 (order: desc < desc+kw < truncated+kw).
then: A passing ranker is frozen with an exam verdict rule written before the exam is opened: on the 133 deepmind-outlets articles, rankers taught from the whole labelled pool (collection + fresh + fresh-2 + fresh-3) by product teaching; MAP over profiles with >= 3 strict relevant exam articles; paired label-stratified article bootstrap (seed 31963); pass when the lower bound against keywordNarrow is > -0.05 and the intervals against keywordBroad and newest lie above 0. The package gains a ranking API before the exam is scored through it.
noneEligible: No ranker is frozen; the exam stays sealed; the round reports why.
